title: Loop
description: An iteration within a run. The persisted status domain is a superset of the model-emittable terminals (the model emits 102/200/202/499; the engine also imposes 413/429/500/508 via direct write, and 100 marks a created-but-unstarted loop). The loop's prompt is replayed on every turn within it; turn.packet.user.prompt is a copy.

status.description: Persisted loop status. Model-emittable: 100 = created (not yet started); 102 = continuing; 200 = terminal success; 499 = terminal give-up/cancellation. Engine-imposed (never a model SEND): 413 = budget overflow; 429 = max turns; 500 = failed (strike-out); 508 = loop detected (cycle).

prompt.description: The original user prompt for this loop, replayed on every turn.
